system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Knight, Hero, or Wuxia.

Only those who agree other than you can be targeted. When you use "Protect" as a target, it will be [Range: 1 Sq.] and you do not become [Post-Action] and can be used even in [Post-Action]. This effect lasts until the end of the scenario.

A special skill that makes a vow of protection with one's own sword. As long as I have this oath, I will never let any blade reach me.
